items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Frankie Asunto; the name is introduced by Speaker_06 in a separate turn.

ctx.x: Well, I puffed not myself, but the biggest puff I've ever seen is Mutt Carey and this boy that called Dizzy Gillespie. Dizzy Gillespie would go like that. Mutt Carey couldn't butt in the shite chair. He couldn't butt in there. He'd bust all that.
I noticed Frankie Asunto puffs a lot. Yeah. Yeah.
I do a little puffing now myself, but I used to do it. Probably if you wake a long time behind them trumpets, you're going to puff out some, you know, come grass with it.
